en.name: LMT MRGG-A 7.62x51mm Marksman Rifle
en.description: LMT's 7.62x51 gas gun built on the company's signature monolithic upper platform. The Modular Rail Gas Gun pairs a one-piece upper and rail for a rock-solid optic-to-bore relationship with an ambidextrous lower and two-stage trigger, delivering the reach and terminal authority of full-power .308 in a semi-automatic package that still handles like a fighting rifle. Purpose-built for designated-marksman and precision duty roles.

en.name: LMT MRP 7.62x51 Monolithic Upper Receiver
en.description: LMT's monolithic upper receiver — a single forging that merges the receiver and free-float rail into one rigid unit. Eliminating the barrel-nut interface preserves optic zero under hard use and gives the rail exceptional stability for lasers, lights and night vision.

en.name: LMT MRGG-A 7.62x51 16 inch barrel
en.description: A 16-inch chrome-lined, cold-hammer-forged 7.62x51 barrel for the LMT monolithic platform. LMT's quick-change barrel design lets the shooter swap tubes without losing zero, and the heavier .308 profile keeps point-of-impact stable through sustained strings of fire.

en.name: LMT AR-10 Low Profile Gas Block
en.description: A low-profile gas block for the AR-10 platform, sitting cleanly beneath a free-float rail. Precisely bored for reliable gas metering with .308-length gas systems, suppressed or unsuppressed.

en.name: LMT AR-10 Ambidextrous Charging Handle
en.description: An ambidextrous extended charging handle for AR-10 pattern rifles, giving positive purchase for support-hand or strong-hand manipulation and clearing optics and mounts without fouling.

en.name: Magpul DT Carbine Stock Black
en.description: A collapsible carbine buttstock with a rubber recoil pad and a snag-free profile. Multiple length-of-pull positions let the shooter tune fit across armor and kit, while the shielded release latch resists accidental collapse.

en.name: Magpul DT Carbine Stock FDE
